name: message-scroller
title: Message Scroller
description: A scrolling message list for a conversation: user turns sit right in pale bubbles, assistant replies run left as plain text, and the view follows a reply while it streams. Scrolling up reveals a button that returns to the newest message.
use: A conversation receives long or streamed replies and the reader should stay at the newest text without scrolling.
avoid: It is only the scroll plumbing; the header, message bubbles and composer are left for you to build.
a11y: No reduced-motion handling: the jump button still slides and scales for users who ask for less motion. (keyboard: yes, labels: good, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: A rounded dark chat card with a Trip planner header, user questions in pale rounded bubbles on the right, and assistant answers as grey left-aligned paragraphs. A muted follow-up bar and a round arrow send button sit along the bottom edge.
behaves: New assistant text streams in and the viewport stays pinned to the bottom while it grows. Scrolling up detaches the pin and fades in a circular arrow button near the bottom, which returns to the latest message when pressed.
customise: Compose the provider, scroller, viewport and items as children with your own message markup; pass autoScroll and defaultScrollPosition to the provider and set the button direction.
weight: light: A scroll container with visibility observers and a small transition on one button.
